# Interpolation models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

3 interpolation models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: two RGB images (consecutive frames). Output: the frame between them at `timestep` (0.5 by default; 0 = the first, 1 = the second), RGB in [0, 1].

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial | kernels time (ms),<br>speed-up vs original | kernels peak memory (MiB, reserved),<br>ratio to original |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`rife-4.25`](#rife) | yes | 31.4, 0.8x | 1516, 1.3x |

## RIFE

RIFE (Practical-RIFE 4.25, 4.26 and 4.25 lite, Huang et al.): makes the frame between two video frames from the optical flow it estimates between them, for slow motion and higher frame rates. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rife-4.25` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 24.5<br>36.0<br>31.4<br>44.9<br>17.6 | 987 / 1154<br>999 / 1254<br>1029 / 1516<br>1094 / 1234<br>696 / 714 |
| `rife-4.26` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 24.2<br>35.9<br>31.4<br>44.5<br>17.6 | 1004 / 1154<br>999 / 1254<br>1029 / 1516<br>1094 / 1234<br>696 / 714 |
| `rife-4.25-lite` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 21.3<br>32.7<br>28.9<br>42.3<br>14.1 | 1012 / 1214<br>991 / 1174<br>1024 / 1516<br>1061 / 1374<br>696 / 714 |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Original code: <https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE> at `bbfd2ea90910`
- Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: MIT
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE/blob/bbfd2ea90910789a860ea3e2b32a240cd577b75e/README.md ; https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE/blob/bbfd2ea90910789a860ea3e2b32a240cd577b75e/LICENSE
- Training data: Vimeo-90K (septuplets / triplets for frame interpolation) (The README does not list the training data of the 4.x releases; the RIFE paper (arXiv:2011.06294) trains on Vimeo-90K, the 4.x releases add unnamed data (anime scenes per the 4.25 release note).)
- Options: `cuda_graphs` = True (speed only)
- Kernel libraries: `cudnn_hacc`
- Variants: `rife-4.25`, `rife-4.26`, `rife-4.25-lite`
- Outputs: frame
- Input size: any H x W >= 128, padded to a multiple of 128
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `rife-4.25` 3000x4000 (5.5 GiB peak allocated, 6.8 reserved); `rife-4.26` 3000x4000 (5.5 GiB peak allocated, 6.8 reserved); `rife-4.25-lite` 3000x4000 (5.5 GiB peak allocated, 6.5 reserved)
- `rife-4.25` 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 36 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 56 s (ONNX + engine).
- `rife-4.26` 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 55 s (ONNX + engine).
- `rife-4.25-lite` 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 50 s (ONNX + engine).
- `rife-4.25` original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream Practical-RIFE Model.inference, timestep 0.5, zero pad to 128, inference_video.py --fp16: half default dtype, model and input
- `rife-4.26` original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream Practical-RIFE Model.inference, timestep 0.5, zero pad to 128, inference_video.py --fp16: half default dtype, model and input
- `rife-4.25-lite` original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream Practical-RIFE Model.inference, timestep 0.5, zero pad to 128, inference_video.py --fp16: half default dtype, model and input
- `rife-4.25` load / first call: original 1.42 s / 0.265 s, portable 0.05 s / 0.255 s, kernels 1.1 s / 0.139 s
- `rife-4.26` load / first call: original 0.18 s / 0.046 s, portable 0.09 s / 0.234 s, kernels 1.12 s / 0.14 s
- `rife-4.25-lite` load / first call: original 0.18 s / 0.12 s, portable 0.05 s / 0.261 s, kernels 1.14 s / 0.137 s
- Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

### Measured

DAVIS 2017 trainval 480p (JPEG), frames 0 / 2 and 20 / 22 of each of the 90 videos give the frame 1 / 21 at time 0.5, compared with the real one: PSNR and SSIM (Gaussian 11 x 11, sigma 1.5) of the output rounded to uint8, on RGB in [0, 1], averaged over the triplets. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

| variant | dataset | original fp32 | original fp16 | portable | kernels | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rife-4.25` | DAVIS 2017 480p, 2 frame triplets per video (180), PSNR / SSIM | 27.13 / 0.8082 | 27.03 / 0.8074 | 27.13 / 0.8081 | 27.13 / 0.8081 |  |
| `rife-4.26` | DAVIS 2017 480p, 2 frame triplets per video (180), PSNR / SSIM | 27.24 / 0.8131 | 27.14 / 0.8123 | 27.24 / 0.8131 | 27.24 / 0.8131 |  |
| `rife-4.25-lite` | DAVIS 2017 480p, 2 frame triplets per video (180), PSNR / SSIM | 26.82 / 0.8011 | 26.70 / 0.8001 | 26.81 / 0.8010 | 26.81 / 0.8010 |  |

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks 5b3a5646, 2026-11-13.

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.00024 and p99 <= 0.0013 (absolute error of the output `frame`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rife-4.25` | 0.00016 / 0.00083 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
| `rife-4.26` | 0.00015 / 0.00075 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
| `rife-4.25-lite` | 0.00015 / 0.00078 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
